column1: # `spec-pin:` stays in the module header; this file replaces the per-declaration
# `-- pin:` / `-- own:` comments in the source (existing comments are grandfathered
# and still work).  An entry here takes precedence over an in-source marker.
#   module        path relative to lean/ (the checker's module key)
#   declaration   full importable name, namespace prefix included
# A `pin:` file is added to that module's wire.  `own:` is tier 2 (not diffed).
# Changing this file never affects a Lean build; `check_port --strict-markers`
# fails on an entry that no longer matches a declaration.
